text:
Maya Chen: Tiny triumph to report — the partner workshop whiteboard was a sticky note apocalypse at 8:45 and also we had zero markers. I ran to the supply closet and found a sad dry marker, but Samir showed up with a fresh pack and kites of tape. Also discovered a hidden chocolate stash in Marketing. :tada:
Samir Patel: Glad I could sprint over — seconding Maya, the butcher paper + fresh markers saved the flow. Also, the chocolate was a morale MVP. :chocolate_bar: :muscle:
aj: Hero move. Serious props to supply-run Samir. Should we add a spare whiteboard kit to the ops closet?
Devon R: +1 for a kit. I can buy a travel marker set and a tiny roll of tape for the closet. Will drop it by today.
katie_leads: Love this. Can we make a 2-min checklist for workshop hosts (markers, tape, extension cord, HDMI adapter)? I'll pin it to the #workshop-resources doc.
Maya Chen: Yes please. Also shoutout to aj for stalling partners with an impromptu icebreaker while we resurrected the board. :joy:
aj: My 30-second interpretive dance counts as a stall technique.
ops-bot: Incident log created: supply-incident-3165001234. Severity: low. Resolution: ad-hoc supply run.
Samir Patel: If anyone wants the chocolate location, whisper me — I will not tell Marketing I revealed their secret. :see_no_evil:
Devon R: Taking on procurement of the spare kit. ETA this afternoon.
katie_leads: Quick poll: should we label the kit with a sticker? React with :one: for yes, :two: for no.
Maya Chen: :one:
aj: :one:
Samir Patel: :one:
Devon R: :one:
katie_leads: Sticker it is. Thanks y'all — tiny ops win but big vibes. :sparkles:
